name: Top Half Pull-up
how_to:
1. Stand on a box or jump up so your chin starts above the bar.
2. Lower yourself halfway down (elbows reach roughly a 90-degree bend).
3. Pause briefly, then pull back up until your chin clears the bar again.
4. Repeat for 3–8 reps, maintaining tension and control throughout.
5. Avoid full extension at the bottom; stay in the upper half of the range.
